# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_FOR_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-09-06
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The baseline engine enters bearish put trades on 4/29 and 5/01 when VIX is too low (<15) or flat/falling, resulting in losing trades. By adding a VIX filter requiring VIX≥15 and (VIX rising or above 20) for put entries, we avoid low-quality entries and only take trades when the options market prices fear, improving win rate on bearish setup days.

## Mechanism

Add a pre-entry filter in BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON: for put (bearish) signals, require current VIX ≥ 15 AND (VIX > prior bar's VIX OR VIX ≥ 20). If condition fails, skip entry. Uses same VIX data source as existing setup.
